a: Semantic tags like header, main, article describe meaning, not just layout.
alt text describes images for accessibility and when images fail.
form method=get/post controls how data is sent.
input types include text, email, password, number, checkbox, radio.
viewport meta tag is required for responsive mobile layouts.
script defer downloads in parallel and runs after HTML is parsed.
Use labels, roles, and keyboard focus for accessible pages.
canvas provides a drawing surface controlled by JavaScript.
localStorage persists key-value strings in the browser.
